en: MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed[/n]to deliver the DEVON GOODS.[/p]Would you like to sail back to[/n]DEWFORD, then?
MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then![/p]Anchors aweigh![/n]PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver[/n]the DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in[/n]SLATEPORT![/p]You just go on and tell me whenever[/n]you want to set sail again!
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy![/n]For you, I'll go out to sea anytime![/p]Now, my friend, where are we bound?
MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever[/n]you need to set sail again!
Yo, TRAINERS![/n]Whether you're hot to trot,[/l]or cool cat not,[/l]chill at my papa's spot!
Our sand castle's taking a long time[/n]to make.
You can have this!
ZIGZAGOON: Guguu?
I want to get going to SLATEPORT and[/n]kick up a ruckus!
This is my first job after joining[/n]TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.
TEAM AQUA's actions should bring[/n]smiles to people's faces!
Yikes![/n]You're better than I expected!
Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE[/n]at full speed on CYCLING ROAD?
How do you like the way my raven-[/n]colored hair streams behind me?[/p]I grew my hair out just for that.
I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take[/n]a leisurely walk on the low road.
Which should I choose?[/p]Make a beeline for MAUVILLE on[/n]CYCLING ROAD, or take the low road[/l]and look for POKéMON?
Your technique is remarkable.[/p]I suggest you speed up a bit while[/n]still avoiding collisions.
I would consider you a work in[/n]progress.[/p]Still, I hope you don't forget the[/n]sheer pleasure of cycling.
Regardless of the results, I count on[/n]seeing more challenges from you.[/l]Always aim higher!
